_about: Headline numbers for the promo, copied from RESULTS.md / README.md / best-config.json. Speed values are [value, ledger label, ledger case] and are checked against runs/ledger.jsonl (decode_tps, or prefill_tps for pp-* and needle-* cases); needle results [ctx, label, case] read 'found' from the same file; codeeval against runs/codeeval-<label>.json; KLD [value, run] against runs/kld/summary.txt; the card line's failed allocation against its server log; statements in 'text' are matched word for word in RESULTS.md. promo/tools/prep.py refuses to mark the set measured if any differ. Derived numbers (speed-ups, lever gains, means of controls) are computed in prep and compared with the rounded figures RESULTS.md states.

model.name: Maxwell-V1-Flash
model._source: RESULTS.md: '35B MoE, ~3B active; 45 layers: 3 dense + 42 with 256 routed experts, top-12'

stock._what: stock llama.cpp flags on the port build: --fit picks the split, f16 KV, ub 512, mmap, 64k (PLAN row 1 rerun on a quiet host)

tuned._what: serve.sh default = configs/13-ub1024-cache1900.json, qualification batch b12 (F1-F3)

levers._what: each lever against the controls run either side of it (PLAN / RESULTS 'What was tried' rows)

results_md._what: figures RESULTS.md states as rounded; prep checks its own derivations against these

text._what: statements the copy and plates make that are not in the ledger; each must appear word for word in RESULTS.md (or README.md where marked)
text.needles_62k: At 59–62k (90–94%) none of 4 base runs was clean
text.needles_32k: At 32k (48% of the window) all three codes come back exactly in every base run (4 of 4)
text.f16_crossover: f16 is faster from about 4k tokens of context
text.lora_halves: halves decode: 23.2 tok/s against 47.6 / 47.3 base controls
text.quant_drift: Quant drift against BF16 is not measured here.
text.card_line: The model card's line (`-ngl 99 -c 32768`) does not load on 12 GB.
text.readme_q8_35: q8_0 KV decodes 35% slower than f16 at 32k
